## Samsung Display Restarts Asan A7 OLED Line on Rising Foldable and IT Panel Demand

An A7 line restart is a tangible demand signal in foldable and IT OLED; positive read-through for device OEMs and panel-adjacent supply chains, and supports a recovery thesis in premium mobile and PC form factors.

- Samsung Display has restarted its Asan A7 manufacturing plant, citing rising demand for foldable and IT OLED panels.
- The restart is a capacity commitment signal pointing to genuine demand improvement in both handset and PC/tablet display segments.
- No ramp timeline or volume targets are specified in coverage.
- The move is a positive demand-side data point for downstream device supply chains reliant on Samsung OLED.
